description: Lists all jurisdictions and regions supported by Legis-Link for a specific trade. Use this tool before calling other tools to confirm that the target region is supported, or to discover available regions when the user has not specified one. Returns a structured list of countries and their sub-regions (states, provinces, nations) along with the primary standards that apply in each region.

api_key.description: Legis-Link API key. Optional: leave empty for the free tier (a daily question limit applies); Pro users paste their ll_p_ key.

trade.description: The trade for which to list supported regions.

name: list_supported_regions
title: List supported regions
